what: Knarr v2 (TTS report section 60.14): Knarr e retrained with channel augmentation (mp3, phone band, low-pass, white/pink noise, reverb; half of all training windows read from the degraded copy, clean targets) and without formant_tracker's reserved Spontal SPLIT_V4 TEST channels and persons
word_rule: as F4N2 (150-frame window centred on the word, top-3 frames of the perc head, mean over seeds) but WITHOUT the voicing gate
test: Swedish creak test set (274 words, user labels): AUC 0.881 (Knarr e 0.874, F4N2 gated 0.796); women 0.895, men 0.893; pool-weighted 0.881
robustness: development words, 8 channel conditions: mean |score change| 0.074 (Knarr e 0.123), mean signed change -0.00 (Knarr e -0.09)
